Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the generation of electricity from biomass energy that is a renewable resource.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electricity from biomass energy that is arenewable resource; and adding a new chapter to Title 36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any county legislative authority mayconstruct, purchase, or acquire a facility to generate electricity frombiomass energy that is a renewable resource under RCW 19.285.030. Thecounty legislative authority has the full authority to regulate andcontrol the use, distribution, sale, and price of the electricityproduced. (2) "County legislative authority" means the board of countycommissioners or the county council.
Section 1 of this act constitutes a newchapter in Title 36 RCW.
